tooltip_definitions.Automotive Revenue: Revenues from R1T, R1S, R2 midsize SUV, and Electric Delivery Van (EDV) retail and commercial deliveries.
tooltip_definitions.Software & Services: Fleet telematics, charging network revenue, vehicle financing, insurance, and maintenance subscriptions.
tooltip_definitions.R2 Midsize Platform: Rivian's high-volume midsize SUV platform manufactured in Normal, Illinois; outsold R1 and EDV in Q3.
tooltip_definitions.Vehicle Deliveries: Customer handoffs of completed production vehicles (19,248 delivered in Q3 2026, +46% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Gross Margin: Gross profit divided by total revenue (8.17% in Q3 2026, positive for the fifth straight quarter).
tooltip_definitions.Operating Loss: Consolidated GAAP loss from operations (-$881.0M in Q3 2026, stable vs -$881.0M in Q1 2026).
tooltip_definitions.True FCF: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures, stock-based compensation, and finance lease additions (-$1,276.0M in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.Volkswagen Joint Venture: Strategic technology partnership with VW Group providing capital infusions and shared zonal architecture.
tooltip_definitions.Clean Regulatory Credits: Environmental credit sales to legacy automakers lacking zero-emission vehicle compliance ($80M recognized in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.Research & Development: Investment in next-gen electrical architecture, autonomy software, and battery cell manufacturing ($485M in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.Selling, General & Administrative: Expenditures on retail spaces, service centers, delivery logistics, and executive operations ($572M in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: Net loss per share attributable to common stockholders (-$0.63 in Q3 2026 vs -$0.72 consensus).
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Cash flow from operations (-$703.0M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Investment in Normal plant retooling and Georgia manufacturing facility ($366.0M in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.Normal Illinois Plant: Primary manufacturing facility producing R1T, R1S, EDV, and the newly ramped R2 SUV.
tooltip_definitions.Georgia Manufacturing Facility: Second manufacturing plant planned to scale global R2 and R3 platform production.
tooltip_definitions.EDV Fleet Deliveries: Custom electric delivery vans delivered to Amazon and commercial logistics operators.
tooltip_definitions.Enterprise Value: Total market capitalization plus debt minus cash ($16.67B at market close).
tooltip_definitions.Options Implied Move: Weekly straddle implied move was ±11.18%; actual move was +5.59% to $12.09.
tooltip_definitions.Cash Fortress: Available cash, cash equivalents, and short-term liquid investments supporting R2 production ramp.
